origin.description: Estimate the cross entropy of X relative to the sample Y.
origin.details: Neighbor distances are from each row of X to the sample Y.
origin.example: crossentropy of the first six rows and the last six rows of cbind(1:10, 1:10), k=2

translation.description: crossentropy uses knnx distances from Y to X and the same volume term as entropy.
translation.details: Neighbor distances are from each row of X to the sample Y.
translation.example: crossentropy of the first six rows and the last six rows of cbind(1:10, 1:10), k=2
